name: KV Baltic / VMG Industrial Park data center proposal
notes: Klaipeda-region/Dirvupiai industrial park marketed for data-center development; trade/source material describes KV Baltic and VMG proposal and on-site substation access to 60 MW, extendable to 110 MW. Treat as proposed/marketed site rather than confirmed tenant build.

name: Kruonis Technology Park data center site
developer: Invest Lithuania / Ministry of Energy / Ignitis Group
notes: Government-backed Kruonis Technology Park is designed for data-centre development beside the Kruonis pumped-storage plant; ministry says about 500 MW can currently be provided and long-term potential could exceed 1 GW. No named tenant identified.

name: Telecentras VDC5 Kaunas
developer: AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras (Telecentras)
notes: Telecentras state data-centre expansion program lists planned VDC5 construction in Kaunas; DCD reported intended 100-rack capacity.

name: Telecentras VDC6 Sitkunai / Kaunas district
developer: AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras (Telecentras)
notes: Telecentras state data-centre expansion program lists DC6 start in Kaunas district/Sitkunai as planned; DCD reported 96-rack target and 2025 launch timing.

name: Cherry Servers Siauliai data center
notes: Cherry Servers lists Siauliai, Lithuania as a data-center location at Tilzes 74-320 with bare metal, VPS, VDS and custom-server products.

name: Bacloud Lithuania data center
notes: Bacloud official materials place its main Lithuanian data center in Siauliai and state it has operated since 2006.

name: Telia Lietuva next-generation Vilnius data center, Raisteniskes
notes: Telia official page describes an AI-ready Tier III-designed Vilnius facility scalable from 3 MW to 10 MW; DCD reported construction start, EUR 26m cost, Conres LT developer and 2027 completion target.

name: Telecentras VDC3 and VDC4 Vilnius state data centers
developer: AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras (Telecentras)
notes: Telecentras project page says VDC3 and VDC4 launched on 2024-09-30 with combined capacity of 288 cabinets; DCD reports DC4 at 1.5 MW and 96 racks.

name: Delska EU North Vilnius LT DC1 expansion
notes: Delska official portfolio lists Vilnius LT DC1 as an operating 2 MW/220-rack Tier III facility; Baltic Times reports Delska plans to expand the LT DC1 site up to 20 MW on the existing facility and adjacent owned land.

name: Delska EU North Vilnius LT DC2
notes: Delska official data-center portfolio lists EU North Vilnius LT DC2 as a 2 MW, 140-rack facility.

name: Delska EU North Vilnius LT DC3
notes: Delska official data-center portfolio lists EU North Vilnius LT DC3 as a 2 MW, 180-rack facility and describes it as the largest data exchange hub in Lithuania.

name: RackRay data center, Vilnius
notes: Delska announced RackRay joining/merging into Delska Lithuania in 2025; aggregator places the Vilnius RackRay facility at about 600 sqm and 1 MW.

name: Baltneta Vilnius data centers
notes: Baltneta official colocation page describes a Tier 3 dedicated data-centre building with 96 cabinets; aggregator lists three Baltneta Vilnius facilities, including Paneriu and Liepkalnio addresses.
